args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Some notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That label still uses the old name, so it may confuse people searching for Pellow Home Living. It needs updating to the new name.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti
